want: a single short race countdown beep, electronic start-light tone
heard: A single short electronic beep — a clean, near-pure tone (roughly 1 kHz) with a fast attack and a quick, dry decay. It sounds synthesized, small and close, with no reverb or tail to speak of; it just stops.
sounds_like: A race countdown / start-light beep, or a generic digital UI confirmation tone.
problems: Very plain and dry — no tail or spatial character, so it may feel thin or generic on its own. If the game wants a punchier 'light' feel, it could use a touch more body or a subtle short decay tail.
